gpSelfConfirm: Irekhodi lendawo yesi sixhobo lithi udale eli qela. Qinisekisa isazisi sakho sokusayina esiqinisekisiwe ngaphakathi njengomlawuli? Isazisi sokufihla: {0}. Isitshixo sokutyikitya: {1}. Amanye amalungu kufuneka aqinisekise ngokuzimeleyo kwaye aqinisekise wena.
gpAnchorConfirm: Qinisekisa {0} ({1}) njengomlawuli weli qela? Kuphela kwesi sitshixo sokutyikitya esixhotyiweyo siya kuvunyelwa ukuba sigunyazise ukhuseleko oluncitshisiweyo lombhali.
gpDowngradeWarning: La malungu awabhengezi inkxaso yombhali osayinweyo: {0}. Ukuzivumela kuthetha ukuba naliphi na ilungu elinesitshixo seqela ekwabelwana ngalo linokuzenza omnye umbhali. Amalungu akhoyo aya kufumana isaziso esiqhubekayo. Ukurhoxisa kugcina ukhuseleko olungqongqo kwaye akuyamkeli olu tshintsho.
gpUnanchored: Akukho mlawuli uqinisekisiwe. Ukhuseleko olungqongqo alunakuncitshiswa de uqinisekise kwaye uqinisekise umfowunelwa we-admin.
gpDropped: ⚠ Ukhuseleko lombhali luncitshisiwe ngumlawuli we-pinned. Imiyalezo yelifa ayiqinisekisi umbhali ngamnye.
gpRestored: ✓ Ukukhuselwa kombhali osayiniweyo kubuyiselwe. Imiyalezo engatyikitywanga iyaliwe.
gpVerifyFirst: Qinisekisa inombolo yokhuseleko yalo mfowunelwa kuqala, emva koko uqinisekise njengomlawuli kweli qela.
gpFailed: Uhlaziyo lokhuseleko lweqela aluphumelelanga. Utshintsho olungavunyelwanga luhlala luvaliwe.
snV2: Inombolo yokhuseleko v2 · Amanani angama-60 · i-identifier-bound
snLegacy: Inombolo yokhuseleko yelifa · Amasuntswana angama-96. Thelekisa kuphela inguqulelo efanayo; Esi siboniso asitshintshi ukuqinisekiswa.
snVersion: Iinguqulelo ezahlukeneyo zokubonisa. Bobabini bakhetha inombolo yelifa kwaye bathelekise kwakhona. Oku akusiyo ubungqina botshintsho olubalulekileyo.
snMismatch: Uthelekiso lwe-QR aluhambelani. Jonga uqhakamshelwano kunye namaqhosha omabini phambi kokuqinisekisa.
mrIntro: Imiyalezo evela kubantu abangaphandle kwabafowunelwa bakho ihlala apha ude wamkele. Amagama kunye nee-ID aziqinisekisiwe; Thelekisa iminwe ngaphambi kokuthembela komnye umntu.
mrPolicy: Igcinwe kwesi sixhobo ukuya kuthi ga kwiintsuku ezisi-7: abathumeli abangama-20, iimvulophu ezingama-20 nganye, i-100 iyonke, i-2 MiB iyonke (i-128 KiB ngemvulophu nganye). Imiyalezo egqithisileyo kunye neefowuni ezingacelwanga ziyalahliswa. Akukho nto ihlaziyiweyo okanye ihlaziywe ngaphambi kokwamkelwa.
mrFull: Umda wokugcina ufikelelweyo; Imiyalezo emitsha ifakiwe
mrFailed: Ayikwazanga ukuhlaziya izicelo zemiyalezo. Nceda uzame kwakhona.
daLinked: Isixhobo esidityanisiweyo esingazange sibonwe ngaphambili (usayino olukhethekileyo luqinisekisiwe)
daSession: Olunye ufakelo lusebenzise esi sazisi (usayino luqinisekisiwe)
daPush: Olunye ufakelo lubhengeze ubhaliso lokutyhala (utyikityo luqinisekisiwe)
daRelayKeys: Relay inika ingxelo ngamaqhosha e-akhawunti ahlukeneyo okanye alahlekileyo — ukungangqinelani okungaqinisekiswanga
daUnavailable: Ukutshekishwa komsebenzi we-akhawunti akufumaneki okanye akuphelelanga. I-relays inokuba yinto enqamlezileyo. Oku akusiyo ubungqina besixhobo esitsha.
daLimit: Kuphela umsebenzi osayiniweyo, oqwalaselweyo unokuqinisekiswa. I-relay inokubamba iirekhodi. Iingxelo zeseshoni kunye neengxelo zokutyhala zifuna abathengi abaphuculweyo, abasebenzisanayo.
daRecovery: Ukukhupha ukudibanisa kurhoxisa izitshixo zesixhobo eziqinisekisiweyo koontanga abakwaziyo emva kokuba indawo yokujonga esayiniweyo ifikile; Oontanga belifa bayeka kuphela i-fan-out. Isazisi esikhutshelweyo okanye umrhumo wokutyhala awunakurhoxiswa kude apha: buyisela kwisazisi esitsha, yazisa abafowunelwa kwaye uyeke ukusebenzisa isazisi esichaphazelekayo.
cvReverify: Thelekisa amanani okhuseleko uze uqinisekise kwakhona
cvCompare: Thelekisa eli nani kuzo zombini izixhobo. Iquka zombini izitshixo zokubethela kunye nokutyikitya:
cvMissingPin: Isitshixo sokusayina esifakwe kwi-pinned siyafuneka. Qala utshintshe umyalezo oqinisekisiweyo.
cvStrict: Thintela ukuthumela emva kotshintsho lweqhosha de kuqinisekiswe kwakhona
cvFailed: Uqinisekiso aluphumelelanga okanye amaqhosha atshintshiwe ngexesha lothelekiso. Phinda uvule kwaye uthelekise kwakhona.
cvBlocked: Ukuthumela okuvaliwe: amaqhosha oqhagamshelwano atshintshiwe. Thelekisa amanani okhuseleko kwaye uqinisekise kwakhona, okanye ucime imowudi engqongqo kwi-/verify.
vaultNew: Ibinzana elitsha lokudlula le-vault (ubuncinane abalinganiswa abali-12; hayi igama lakho lokugqitha /lock)
vaultLegacy: Ibinzana lokudlula /keywrap elikhoyo, okanye ishiye lisingenanto ukuba alikho
vaultScope: Khusela izitshixo, imiyalezo / iifayile, abafowunelwa, iidrafti kunye nezicwangciso zesikhangeli zabucala kuzo zonke iiakhawunti? Gcina ibinzana lakho lokubuyisela kunye ne-backup yefayile ye-vault kuqala. Umxholo, ulwimi kunye nemvume zihlala esidlangalaleni. /vault lock lock lock zonke iithebhu; /vault-password litshintsha ibinzana lokudlulisa.
vaultDisable: Khubaza i-vault kwiakhawunti nganye? Uqinisekiso luyafuneka. Imbali, iifayile, abafowunelwa, izitshixo, iidrafti kunye nezicwangciso zesikhangeli sabucala ziya kubuyela kwindawo yokugcina.
vaultFailed: Umsebenzi we-Vault awuphumelelanga. Jonga i-passphrase kunye nokugcinwa; Akukho kubuyela umva kombhalo ocacileyo ovumelekileyo.
vaultRecovery: Ayisiyiyo igama eligqithisiweyo /lock. Ukuba ulibalekile, buyisa isazisi sakho usebenzisa ibinzana lakho lokubuyisela kufakelo olutsha. Iiseshoni ezikhoyo ze-vault azinakufumaneka ngaphandle kwale binzana lokudlulisa.
vaultOldTabs: Vala iithebhu ezindala zeBreeze ngaphambi kokutshintsha i-vault.
vaultBackupOnly: Ngelixa i-vault inikwe amandla, ukuthunyelwa ngaphandle kuqulethe kuphela ii-snapshots ze-vault ezifihliweyo. Ukukhutshelwa okuqhotyoshelweyo, ilifu, ukuthunyelwa okuzenzekelayo kunye nokubuyisela kwakhona kukhubazekile.
opScope: Utshintshiselana ngezi sazisi umema ZOMBINI iindlela zobuqu. Ziphela emva kwemizuzu engama-30. Thelekisa iminwe kuzo zombini izixhobo kwaye uqinisekise kuphela ukuba iyahambelana. Gcina le app ivulekile kude kube /rendezvous kugqitywe; Ukulayisha kwakhona kurhoxisa okulindelwe ukudibanisa. Akukho ukhangelo lwe-alias okanye ukuqinisekiswa kwe-relay.
opCompare: Thelekisa le minwe kuzo zombini izixhobo. Ibopha zombini izitshixo zokubethela, ukutyikitya izitshixo kunye nokumema i-nonces.
opConfirmed: Uqhagamshelwano luqinisekisiwe. Vula incoko yakho kwaye utshintshiselane /rendezvous iikhowudi. Imiyalezo iyavulwa emva kokuqinisekiswa kwesitshixo esikhowudiweyo.
opInvalid: Udibaniso olungekho kwi-intanethi aluphumelelanga: alusebenzi, luphelelwe lixesha, lusetyenzisiwe okanye alungqinelani nekhowudi/isitshixo, okanye i-cryptography ayixhaswanga. Rhoxisa ukudibana okulindileyo kwaye utshintshe izimemo ezintsha.
opPending: Gqibezela ukudibanisa ungekho kwi-intanethi /rendezvous phambi kokuba uyithumele. Sebenzisa /offlinepair rhoxisa ukurhoxisa.
opCancelled: Kulindelwe ukudibana okungasebenzi kwi-intanethi. Utshintshiselana ngezimemo ezintsha kuzo zombini izixhobo ukuba uzame kwakhona.
rvScope: Ifuna iseshoni ekhoyo ekhowudiweyo okanye isimemo /offlinepair siqinisekisiwe. Tshintsha iikhowudi zonxibelelwano ngasese nge-QR okanye ikopi / uncamathiselele; Ziphela kwimizuzu eyi-10.
rvQRTooLarge: Le khowudi inkulu kakhulu kwi-QR enye. Sebenzisa ikopi / uncamathisele endaweni yoko.
rvScanUnavailable: Ikhamera ye-QR yokuskena ayifumaneki kwesi sikhangeli. Sebenzisa ikopi / uncamathisele endaweni yoko.
rvReady: Ikhowudi ilungile / isetyenzisiwe. Yikhuphele koontanga bakho, okanye uncamathisele impendulo yabo.
rvCopyFallback: Ikopi ayifumaneki. Khetha kwaye ukhuphele ikhowudi ngesandla.
rvTrust: Qhagamshela kube kanye nge-relay kwaye uqinisekise olu nxibelelwano, okanye ugcwalise /offlinepair kuqala. Isitshixo sokutyikitya esiqhotyoshelweyo kunye neseshoni okanye ukuqinisekiswa okulindileyo kuyafuneka.
rvInvalid: Ikhowudi yonxulumano engasebenziyo okanye inyathelo lokutshintshiselana alichanekanga.
rvExpired: Le khowudi yonxibelelwano iphelelwe lixesha. Yenza entsha.
rvTimeout: Ukuqokelelwa kwe-ICE kuphelelwe lixesha. Nceda uphinde utshintshise.
rvCandidates: Akukho bagqatswa be-ICE abasebenzisekayo phantsi kwezicwangciso zakho zabucala. Khangela inethiwekhi yakho / izicwangciso ze-TURN kwaye wenze kwakhona utshintshiselwano.
rvRedo: Unxibelelwano lwesandla lufuna ukubuyiselwa. Phinda /rendezvous noontanga bakho.
heroDesc: Akukho inombolo yefowuni. Akukho imeyile. Akukho venkile yeapp. Vula ikhonkco, qala ukuncokola. Yonke into efihliweyo ekupheleni ukuya esiphelweni.
inviteDesc: Ngenisa igama lakho uze uqalise — uya kuqhagamshelwa nommemi wakho ngokuzenzekelayo. Akukho miselo yeseva kwaye akukho bhaliso luyafuneka.
featWorksSub: Nasiphi na isikhangeli, nayiphi na i-OS
noCreditCard: Akukho khadi letyala. Akukho imeyile. Akukho bhaliso.
searchContactsHint: Khangela oqhagamshelana nabo okanye uhlobo / lwemiyalelo
emptyContacts: Sebenzisa iqhosha le-Add friend ukongeza uqhagamshelwano.
addContact:
Yongeza uqhagamshelwano:

Ncamathelisa ikhonkco le-Breeze, @alias, isitshixo sikawonke-wonke, okanye umyalezo wesimemo.
Chwetheza "iqela:igama" ukwenza iqela.
upgGroup: Amaqela axhasa ukuya kuthi ga kumalungu {0}.
callSasLabel: Ikhowudi yokuqinisekisa umnxeba — yifunde omnye komnye; kufuneka ingqimanise kuzo zombini izikrini
gcallGenGate: Iifowuni zeqela ezivela kwisixhobo esidibeneyo zifuna wonke umntu kwifowuni kwinguqulelo ye-app yakutshanje
stickersEmpty: Akukho zipakethe zesiko okwangoku. Yongeza imifanekiso okanye ungenise ifayile yepakethi.
stickersTooBig: Lo mfanekiso uneenkcukacha kakhulu ukuba ube yi-sticker
stickersGroupNoCap: Amanye amalungu awakwazi ukufumana izitikha okwangoku
locPeerNoCap: Inkqubo yolu qhagamshelwano ayikuxhasi ukwabelana ngendawo okwangoku
locGroupNoCap: Ukwabelana ngendawo kufuna ilungu ngalinye leqela kwinguqulelo exhasayo
serverNotConfigured: Umncedisi awuqwalaselwanga: KV ukudibana kuyafuneka. Landela ukuseta kwe-README. I-P2P kunye nokudluliselwa komyalezo akufumaneki.
serverNoDefault: Akukho seva imiselwe umiselwe. Yongeza i-relay yakho kwi-Settings → Ii-relays zasekhaya, okanye zibambe i-Breeze kuqala. Cofa le bhanile ukuvula izicwangciso.
gateServerDesc: I-Breeze ayinayo iseva esemthethweni. Yongeza umncedisi wakho ukuze uqalise. Ikhonkco lokumema lodwa akwanelanga — usadinga iseva yakho.
gateServerSteps: Malunga nemizuzu emibini, ngezinyathelo ezi-2: 1) Ngenisa idilesi yeseva yakho. 2) Jonga ifingerprint ebonisiweyo uze uqinisekise.
safetyDesc: Thelekisa le nombolo kunye nomfowunelwa wakho ngokobuqu okanye ngomnxeba wevidiyo. Ukuba bayadibana, unxibelelwano lwakho lukhuselekile.
ktOk: ✅ Iqinisekisiwe ngokuzenzekelayo ngokuchasene neseva yeqhosha lokubonakalisa icace gca log
ktRolled: ⚠️ Isitshixo salo mfowunelwa siguqukile ukusukela ekutshekisweni kwakho kokugqibela — qinisekisa inombolo yokhuseleko engentla ngononophelo
ktTampered: 🚨 Ifayili engundoqo yokungena yeseva ibonakala ngathi iphazamisekile — ungayithembi le nombolo yokhuseleko
ktUnavailable: I-Key-transparency check ayifumaneki (ingekho kwi-intanethi okanye ayikho iseva)
deposited: Ifakwe kwi-relay — ayikafunyanwa ngabo. I-imeyile engahanjiswanga igcinwa ubukhulu becala iintsuku ezisi-7
backupCreated: Ugcino lwe-backup lugqityiwe! Khumbula i-password yakho.
backupRelayDisabled: Olu hlaziyo alugcini ugcino lwezinto ezikhuselayo. Gcina ifayili yokhuselo endaweni yoko, okanye sebenzisa i-relay oyisebenzisayo.
toastRecoveryNoneBackup: Esi sazisi siyalahlwa (akukho kubuyiselwa), ngoko ke ii-backups azikwazi ukudalwa.
backupWrongPass: Ibinzana lokudlula elingachanekanga okanye ugcino lwenkxaso eyonakeleyo.
backupPassMin: Ibinzana lokugqitha kufuneka libe neempawu ezi-6 ubuncinci.
autoBackupNoServer: I-relay yakho ayigcini i-backups, ngoko ke ugcino oluzenzekelayo alunakuqhuba
autoBackupNeedPass: Faka ibizana lakho lokudlula lokhuselo kanye kwesi sixhobo ukuze uqalise ugcino oluzenzekelayo
autoRestoreFoundDesc: I-backup yale akhawunti ifunyenwe kwi-relay yakho. Yibuyisele ngoku? Idatha kwesi sixhobo iya kutshintshwa yi-backup.
migrateGuideDesc: 1. Kwesi sixhobo, gcina i-backup kwi-relay yakho (i-backup ngokuzenzekelayo ngasentla, okanye Yenza i-Backup). 2. Kwisixhobo esitsha, khetha ukhetho lokubuyisela kwiscreen sokuqala kwaye ufake ibinzana lakho lokubuyisela - okanye igama lakho leakhawunti kunye nebinzana lokugqithisa. 3. Xa isazisi sakho sibuyile, i-backup kwi-relay yakho ifumaneka ngokuzenzekelayo kwaye inikezelwa ukubuyiselwa. Akukho zixhobo okanye iifayile ezifunekayo.
backupNote: I-E2E ibhalwe ngokufihlakeleyo. I-relay igcina kuphela umbhalo ofihlakeleyo - kwaye kuphela ukuba umqhubi wayo wenza ukuba ugcine ugcino. Khumbula i-password yakho.
debugOn: Inkqubo yokulungisa isiphene KWENYE (layisha kwakhona ukufaka isicelo)
debugOff: Inkqubo yokulungisa isiphene icinyiwe (layisha kwakhona ukufaka isicelo)
noteEmpty: Akukho nqaku elimiselweyo. Sebenzisa /note <text> ukongeza enye.
dropRevealed: ✅ Imfihlo ityhilwe — eli khonkco ngoku litshatyalaliswe.
dropReadExpired: 🚫 Le mfihlelo sele ifundwe okanye iphelelwe lixesha.
dropReadFailed: ❌ Ayiphumelelanga ukukhupha ikhowudi. Ikhonki isenokuba ayisebenzi okanye yonakele.
consentText: I-Breeze igcina imiyalezo efihliweyo kunye nezicwangciso ezifihliweyo kwisixhobo sakho. Akukho datha ithunyelwa kubantu besithathu.
noIDBDesc: I-IndexedDB ayifumaneki. Oku kunokwenzeka kwimowudi yabucala / ye-incognito. I-Breeze ifuna ukugcinwa ukugcina izitshixo zakho kunye nemiyalezo ngokukhuselekileyo.
noCryptoDesc: I-WebCrypto API ayifumaneki. I-Breeze ifuna i-HTTPS kunye nesikhangeli sanamhlanje sokubethela ukuphela kokuphela.
noCryptoHint: Nceda ufikelele kwi-Breeze ngaphezulu kwe-HTTPS (hayi i-HTTP).
wipeDesc: Cima ngokusisigxina yonke imiyalezo, uqhagamshelwano, izitshixo nemimiselo
labelNoneHint: Akukho ziilebheli okwangoku. Cofa ekunene kwesokunene kumntu oqhagamshelana naye okanye usebenzise /label
labelNoneContacts: Akukho ziilebheli okwangoku. Cofa ekunene oqhagamshelana naye ukongeza omnye.
labelNoneCmd: Akukho ziilebheli. Sebenzisa /label umsebenzi, usapho ukongezelela.
backupPassSet: Misela ibinzana lokudlula ukwenzela inkxaso yakho:
keyWrapPassPrompt: Misela ibinzana lokudlulisa elineqhosha loqhubekeko-maqhosha (imizuzu eyi-8 yezikwere):
keyWrapUnlockPrompt: Ngenisa ibinzana lokudlula leqhosha le-page-wrap ukwenzela ukuvula:
keyWrapEnabled: Uqhubekeko lweqhosha lokuphumla lenziwe ukuba lisebenze (PBKDF2 ×600k)
keyWrapDisabled: Isivumelwano seqhosha lokuphumla silenziwe ukuba lungasebenzi
keyWrapChangeFailed: Utshintsho kwiqhosha loqhubekeko-maqhosha aluphumelelanga - amaqhosha agciniweyo akutshintshwanga. Jonga i-password kunye nokugcinwa, emva koko uzame kwakhona.
keyWrapMin: Ibinzana lokudlula kufuneka libe neempawu eziyi-8 ubuncinane
connP2PDesc: Unxibelelwano olufihlakeleyo oluthe ngqo ekupheleni ukuya esiphelweni — akukho seva ibandakanyekayo
connRelayDesc: Relay yeseva - imiyalezo ekhowudiweyo ukusuka esiphelweni ukuya esiphelweni
connOffline: Oontanga babonakala bengaxhunyiwe kwi-intanethi. Imiyalezo iya kuhanjiswa nge-relay xa ibuya.
installBannerPlatform: Yongeza kwi-{0} yakho — isebenza ungekho kwi-intanethi
installBannerIOSTip: Cofa ukwabelana uze Yongeza kwiscreen sasekhaya
dropDesc: Ikhonkco lexesha elinye. Ukuzitshabalalisa emva kokufunda. Isitshixo sihlala kwisiqendu se-URL (esingazange sithunyelwe kwiseva).
dropExpires: Iphelelwa lixesha kwiiyure ezingama-24 ukuba ayifundwanga.
keyChanged: ⚠️ Isitshixo sokhuseleko sitshintshelwe {0}. Qinisekisa isazisi sakho kunye /verify.
relayKeyChanged: ⚠️ Isitshixo sokhuseleko sale relay sitshintshile — unxibelelwano lokudlulisela lumisiwe. Qinisekisa iminwe yeminwe yokudlulisela kunye nomsebenzisi phambi kokuba uyithembe kwakhona.
relayPinned: Isazisi sokuhambisa sifakwe - iminwe {0}. Yithelekise neminwe epapashwe ngumqhubi wakho we-relay.
relayAddConfirm: Yongeza {0} njenge-relays yasekhaya? Iminwe: {1} - yongeza kuphela ukuba oku kuyahambelana neminwe epapashwe ngumqhubi we-relay.
relayAddSelf: Loo URL yile relay ngokwayo — sele i-relay yakho yasekhaya.
relayAddDuplicate: Le relay sele ikwi-relays yakho yasekhaya.
relayAddKeyless: Loo relay ayinaso isitshixo sesazisi, ngoko ayinakufakwa - ayinakongezwa njenge-relay yasekhaya.
relayAddInsecure: Elo relay lisebenzisa i-http://, engakhuselekanga — sebenzisa idilesi yalo ye-https:// endaweni yoko. (I-http:// yamkelwa kuphela kwi-relay esebenza kulo sixhobo sokwalo.)
relayAddUnreachable: Loo relay ayikwazanga ukuqinisekiswa — khangela i-URL uze uzame kwakhona.
relayAddTimeout: Eseva ithathe ixesha elide kakhulu ukuphendula — linda umzuzwana uze uzame kwakhona. Ukuba iyaqhubeka, qiniseka ukuba iseva iyasebenza kwaye ayithwalanga ngokugqithisileyo.
relayAddNotBreeze: Loo dilesi iphendule, kodwa ayibonakali njengeseva yeBreeze — qiniseka ukuba i-URL ijonge kwiseva yakho yeBreeze, hayi kwiwebhusayithi okanye enye i-app, uze uzame kwakhona.
relayAddedInvitePrompt: Iseva yongeziwe. Emva koko, mema umhlobo ukuze uqalise incoko.
gateJoinInvite: Joyina igumbi lika {0} — akukho server edingekayo
gateJoinInviteAnon: Joyina igumbi lomntu okumemeleyo — akukho server edingekayo
gateJoinedStarted: Ujoyine kwesi sixhobo. Yenza i-ID yakho ukuze uqhagamshelane nomntu okumemeleyo.
deliveryHintText: Imiyalezo eyi-{0} isekuphela kwesi sixhobo kuphela. Akukho relay eziphume ezo, kwaye u-{1} akaxhunyiwe. Ukuba nihlanganyele, senza ukwenziwa kwenxulumano buqwalaselwe ukuze zifike.
hostWaitText: Igumbi lakho livulekile. Ukujoyina kwenzeka kuphela kwesinye isixhobo, ngoko akukho nto ibonakala apha xa umntu ejoyina. Ukuqalisa ukuthetha buqwalaselwe, xhumanisa ubuso ngobuso.
gateLocalDesc: Abantu abakufutshane: esi sixhobo sisebenza njenge-server xa sikuko kwaye siphapheme. Ukusethwa kwaso akuze kube usebenzisa server yangaphandle.
gateLocalStarted: I-server iqalile kwesi sixhobo. Mema abantu abakufutshane ukuba bathe udibanise.
billingPaidDesc: Le seva ifuna intlawulo kwaye umphathi wayo wamukela imali ngokuthe ngqo — imali ayifiki kumbhali weBreeze. Emva kokuhlawula, faka ikhowudi (okanye ireferensi yakho yokuhlawula) ukusebenzisa le seva.
billingPassPrompt: Faka ikhowudi yakho (bzpass_…) okanye ireferensi yakho yokuhlawula
billingPassOk: Ikhowudi yamkelwe. Le seva ilungele ukusetyenziswa.
billingPassInvalid: Leyo khowudi (okanye ireferensi yokuhlawula) ayizange yamkelwe yiseva.
billingPassNeeded: Le seva ifuna ikhowudi yokuhlawula esebenzayo. Yongeze kwakhona seva ukuze ufake enye.
relayFailover: I-Relay {0} ayiphendulanga - ihanjiswe nge-{1} endaweni yoko.

simpleDesc: I-backup yakho efihliweyo iya kugcinwa kwi-relay oyisebenzisayo okanye ikhontrakthi - oku akuzange kunikezelwe kwi-relay engagqibekanga. Kwisixhobo esitsha, igama leakhawunti yakho + ibinzana lokugqitha libuyisela yonke i-akhawunti, ngaphandle kwebinzana lokubhala. Ibuthathaka kunebinzana lokubuyisela: nabani na oqhuba loo relay uphethe i-ciphertext kwaye unokubona ukuba le akhawunti ine-backup kwaye xa itshintsha, kwaye ibinzana lokugqitha eliqikelelweyo liyayivula. I-relay ayinakuze iyifunde — kuphela ibinzana lokugqitha elikwaziyo. Khetha enye ende.
simpleNewDesc: Khetha igama leakhawunti yokubuyisela - njengedilesi ye-imeyile, kwaye kuya kufuneka uyikhumbule ngokuchanekileyo - kunye nebinzana lokugqitha lokubuyisela ubuncinci abalinganiswa abasi-8. Ngokudibeneyo bathatha kwaye bavule i-backup yakho kwisixhobo esitsha. Akukho namnye othunyelwa kwi-relay; kuphela into abayivulayo.

migrateHtml:
Migrate from LINE / WhatsApp / Telegram
Step 1: Invite contacts (1-on-1)
Type /invite to copy an invite message → paste in LINE/WhatsApp
Type /qr to show a QR code → let them scan it
Step 1b: Move a whole group
Type /newgroup Your Group Name → generates an invite link
→ Paste the link in your LINE/WhatsApp group
→ Members just open the link to join automatically
Step 2: Import chat history
LINE: Chat → Settings → Send chat history → save .txt file
WhatsApp: Chat → More → Export chat → .txt
Telegram: Settings → Advanced → Export data → JSON
Type /import and select the file, or drag-drop onto the chat area
Step 3: Set up notifications
Allow browser notifications to get alerts for new messages
Add to Home Screen for an app-like experience

helpSetKtBlock: Ithintela iseshoni entsha ekhowudiweyo ukuba imbali yokucaca kwesitshixo ibonakala itshintshiwe okanye ikhonkco layo eligciniweyo alinganeni. Oku kukhuselekile kunesilumkiso kuphela, kodwa kunokukumisa ekuthumeleni imiyalezo de utshintsho oluphambili luqinisekiswe okanye useto lucinyiwe.
helpSetBackup: Yenza ulondolozo olufihliweyo kwi-relay yakho xa ugcino lwe-backup lukhona. I-relay igcina kuphela umbhalo ofihlakeleyo, kodwa ukulibala ibinzana lokudlula kuthetha ukuba ugcino alunakubuyiselwa.
helpSetRestore: Fumana i-backup efihliweyo yale akhawunti kwi-relays yakho yasekhaya kwaye uyibuyisele emva kokuba ufake igama lokugqitha elifunekayo. Ukubuyisela idatha kwesi sixhobo, ngoko yisebenzise ngononophelo.
helpSetAutoBackup: Igcina ngokuzenzekelayo i-backup efihliweyo emva kokuba idatha yakho itshintshe. Isebenza kuphela emva kokuba ufake i-password yogcino kwesi sixhobo, kwaye kuphela ukuba i-relay yakho ibonelela ngokugcinwa kwe-backup.
helpSetAutobackupArm: Ikuvumela ukuba ufake ibinzana lokudlula lolondolozo kube kanye ukuze ulondolozo oluzenzekelayo lusebenze ngeli xesha. Ibinzana lokugqitha ligcinwa kuphela kwimemori, ke kuya kufuneka uyifake kwakhona emva kokulayisha kwakhona usetyenziso.
helpSetMigrateDevice: Ivula isikhokelo senyathelo ngenyathelo sokuhambisa le akhawunti kwesinye isixhobo usebenzisa ibinzana lakho lokubuyisela okanye iakhawunti yokubuyisela kunye nebinzana lokugqithisa. Isazisi sakho asiyi kukhutshelwa de ugqibe amanyathelo okubuyisela kwisixhobo esitsha.
helpSetHideRr: Yeka ukuthumela iirisithi zokufunda xa uvula incoko yomntu ngamnye. Abathumeli abayi kubona xa ufunda imiyalezo yabo; imiyalezo ngokwayo isafika ngesiqhelo.
helpSetHideTyping: Yeka ukuthumela isalathiso sokuchwetheza ngelixa ubhala. Abafowunelwa bakho abayi kubona xa ubhala impendulo, kodwa usenokubona eyabo ukuba babelana ngayo.
helpSetRelayOnly: Ihambisa ukugcwala koontanga ngokusebenzisa iiseva zokuhambisa endaweni yonxibelelwano oluthe ngqo, ukufihla idilesi yakho ye-IP kubafowunelwa. Inokwenza iifowuni kunye nokuhanjiswa kwefayile kucothe okanye kungaphumeleli xa kungekho relay esetyenziswayo, kwaye umqhubi we-relay usenokubona imethadatha yonxibelelwano.
helpSetNotifSound: Idlala isandi esifutshane xa umyalezo okanye umnxeba ovumelekileyo ukuba ukwazise ufika. Izaziso ezibonakalayo zahlukile, kwaye imowudi yokugxila okanye iincoko ezithulileyo zinokuthulisa izilumkiso.

helpSetTabVisContacts: Ibonisa okanye ifihle i-tab yabaQhagamshelwano kwi-tab bar esezantsi. Ukuyifihla akucimi uqhagamshelwano lwakho okanye iincoko.
helpSetTabVisSelf: Ibonisa okanye ifihla i-tab ye-Profile kwi-tab bar esezantsi. Iprofayile yakho ihlala ikhona, kwaye oku akutshintshi ukuba kwabelwana ngako.
helpSetTabVisSettings: Ibonisa okanye ifihla ithebhu yezicwangciso kwibar yethebhu esezantsi. Ukuba uyifihla ngelixa usebenzisa Useto, iBreeze ibuyela kwiiNgxoxo; Izicwangciso zihlala zifumaneka kwiqhosha lezicwangciso okanye imiyalelo.
helpSetCallHistoryLog: Igcina uluhlu lwengingqi lweefowuni eziphumayo, ezingenayo, neziphosiweyo kwesi sixhobo. Yicime ukuze umise iirekhodi ezintsha zefowuni apha; ayicimi imbali esele igciniwe.
helpSetAutoLock: Ukuba iphasiwedi yokutshixa usetyenziso isetiwe, itshixa iBreeze xa utshintsha kude nethebhu yayo. Uya kuyidinga loo phasiwedi xa ubuya; Oku akuthathi indawo yokutshixa isixhobo ngokwaso.
helpSetNotifPerm: Cela isikhangeli okanye inkqubo yokusebenza imvume yokubonisa izaziso. I-Breeze ayikwazi ukunika le nto ngokwayo; Ukuba imvume ayizange ivunyelwe ngaphambili, kungafuneka uyitshintshe kwisikhangeli okanye kuseto lwenkqubo.
helpSetShowPeerName: Ibonisa igama umfowunelwa azikhethele lona ecaleni kwesiteketiso osinike sona. Oku kutshintsha kuphela into oyibonayo ekuhlaleni; Akukho nto eyongezelelweyo ithunyelwa kunxibelelwano okanye kwi-relay.
helpSetAddRelay: Yongeza enye i-relay yasekhaya emva kokubonisa iminwe yayo yokuqinisekisa. Ii-relays zasekhaya ezongezelelweyo zinokuphucula ukufumaneka, kodwa nganye inokubona imethadatha efana nexesha kunye nokuba ingakanani i-traffic efihliweyo edlula kuyo.
helpSetRemoveRelay: Isusa enye i-relay yasekhaya eyongezelelweyo kuluhlu lwesi sixhobo. I-relay igcina i-ciphertext esele ifunyenwe kude kube kuphele okuqhelekileyo; Ukususwa kuthintela kuphela iikopi zexesha elizayo ekusebenziseni loo relay.
helpSetFanout: Kubafowunelwa abasebenzisa ii-relays ezininzi zasekhaya, thumela ikopi yomyalezo ngamnye kolu uninzi lwezo relays. Iikopi ezininzi zinokuphucula ukuhanjiswa ukuba enye i-relay iphantsi, kodwa zisebenzisa i-traffic yenethiwekhi kunye nokugcina i-ciphertext kwiindawo ezininzi.
helpSetPowerMode: Ilawula ukuba iBreeze inciphisa kangakanani ukujonga ngasemva ukugcina ibhetri. Ukuthumela akulibazisekanga, kodwa uMgcini kunye noNgxamiseko banokwenza imiyalezo engenayo kunye nohlaziyo lobukho lufike kamva; Ilandela ngokuzenzekelayo ibhetri yakho xa isikhangeli sichaza ngayo.
helpSetRrDelay: Linda malunga nemizuzu emibini, kunye nokwahluka okuncinci okungahleliwe, ngaphambi kokuthumela irisithi yokufunda. Oku kwenza ukuba ixesha lakho lokufunda lingachanekanga, kodwa abathumeli ekugqibeleni bafunda ukuba umyalezo ufundwe.
helpSetFocus: Vula i-Focus mode iyure enye. Uninzi lwezilumkiso zemiyalezo zithuliwe ngelixa zivuliwe; Abafowunelwa be-VIP kunye nokukhankanywa kusenokukwazisa ngaphandle kokuba imowudi engqongqo ivuliwe.
helpSetFocusStrict: Isusa i-VIP kwaye ikhakanye izinto ezingafaniyo kwimowudi yokugxila, ke izilumkiso zemiyalezo zihlala zithule kuye wonke umntu. Izandi zeringi zomnxeba ezingenayo nazo ziyacinezelwa, nangona inkqubo yakho isenokubonisa isaziso esibonakalayo.
helpSetRestoreFile: Ibuyisela ugcino lokhuselo olukhowudiweyo kwifayili obuyigcinile ngaphambili. Ufuna i-password yokugcina, kwaye idatha ebuyiselweyo ithatha indawo yento ekwesi sixhobo.
helpSetInviteFriend: Yenza ikhonkco okanye umyalezo umntu angawusebenzisa ukukongeza kwi-Breeze. Nabani na onayo ikhonkco unokulisebenzisa, ke wabelane ngalo kuphela nomntu oceba ukumema.
helpSetMigrateApps: Ivula isikhokelo sokuhambisa abafowunelwa okanye amaqela ukusuka kwi-LINE, WhatsApp, okanye iTelegram ukuya kwi-Breeze, kubandakanya ukungenisa imbali yengxoxo yokuzikhethela. Imbali engenisiweyo iqulethe kuphela into enye i-app ethunyelwe ngaphandle.
cfStatusSaved: Umqondiso ugciniwe kwesi sixhobo, kodwa akuqinisekiswanga okwangoku.
cfStatusConnectedNoAccounts: Ithokheni iqinisekisiwe. Ubume bethokheni: {0}; Akukho zixhobo zibonakalayo kulo mqondiso.
cfErrNoProxy: Ukuseta i-Cloudflare kufuna i-Breeze relay elungiselelwe i-API proxy. Yongeza i-relay yasekhaya kuqala, okanye uzenzele i-Breeze kwaye uqhube ukuseta apho.
cfNote: I-token igcinwa kuphela kwesi sixhobo. Izicelo zesikhangeli zidlula ngokungenambuso kwi-/api / cf-proxy yale mvelaphi ukuya kwi-Cloudflare's API ngaphandle kokungena okanye ukugcinwa. Ii-relays eziqinisekisiweyo ezinesitshixo sokudlulisela zongezwa kwi-Home Relays ngokuzenzekelayo.
helpSetCloudflareSave: Igcina ithokheni ye-Cloudflare API kuphela kwivenkile yezicwangciso ze-IndexedDB zesi sixhobo. Ithunyelwa kuphela kwi-API ye-Cloudflare njengethokheni ye-Bearer, ingaze idluliselwe kwi-Breeze relays. Ukucwangciswa kweseva kufuna ithokheni kunye neakhawunti efundwayo (uluhlu lwee-akhawunti), ukuhlela kweZikripthi zaBasebenzi, kunye neemvume zokuhlela ze-KV Storage zabasebenzi.
helpSetCloudflareVerify: Ibiza ukuqinisekiswa kwethokheni ye-Cloudflare kunye nee-API zoluhlu lweakhawunti kunye nethokheni egcinwe kwesi sixhobo, emva koko ibonisa imeko yethokheni yokwenyani kunye namagama eakhawunti okanye impazamo yokwenyani. Ithokheni ithunyelwa kuphela kwi-API ye-Cloudflare. Ukucwangciswa komncedisi kufuna ukufundwa kweakhawunti (uluhlu lwee-akhawunti), Izikripthi zaBasebenzi ukuhlela, kunye neemvume zokuhlela Abasebenzi KV Storage.
helpSetCloudflareDisconnect: Icima ithokheni ye-Cloudflare API egciniweyo kwivenkile yezicwangciso ze-IndexedDB yesi sixhobo kwaye icime imeko yonxibelelwano ebonisiweyo. Ayirhoxisi ithokheni, kwaye ayicimi umsebenzi, isithuba segama le-KV, okanye nasiphi na esinye isibonelelo kwiakhawunti yakho ye Cloudflare.
cfSetupDone: Umncedisi ulungele kwaye uhlolwe ngempilo: {0}. Yongeza njenge-relays yasekhaya kwicandelo le-Relays.
cfSetupUnverified: Abasebenzi bathunyelwa kwi-{0}, kodwa uhlolo lwempilo aluzange luphendule ({1}). Yongeza njenge-relay yasekhaya kuphela emva kokuyijonga.
cfStepKv: Ukufumana okanye ukudala indawo yokugcina i KV
cfErrNoAccount: Akukho akhawunti ye-Cloudflare ebonakalayo kulo mqondiso
helpSetCloudflareSetup: Yenza okanye isebenzise kwakhona indawo yegama ye-KV yobukho bempepho, ilayisha i-Breeze Worker ehlanganisiweyo njengeskripthi se-breeze kunye nokubopha kwe-KV efunekayo, yenza idilesi yayo ye-workers.dev, kwaye ijonge /api/impilo. Ithokheni ifuna ukufundwa kweakhawunti (uluhlu lwee-akhawunti), i-Workers Scripts edit, kunye ne-Workers KV Storage edit. I-URL yomncedisi igcinwa kwesi sixhobo kuphela; Yongeza njenge-relays yasekhaya ukuba ufuna ukuyisebenzisa. Ukuseta akuqwalaseli iimfihlo zokuzikhethela zezaziso zokutyhala, i-TURN, okanye isitshixo sesazisi sokuhambisa, ke ezo mpawu zihlala zicimile okanye zibuyela umva ezingagqibekanga de ziqwalaselwe kwideshibhodi ye-Cloudflare.
lnSimilar: "{0}" ifana noqhagamshelwano olukhoyo "{1}" ({2}). Thelekisa iminwe ngaphambi kokuthembela kweli gama.
lnUnsafe: "{0}" iqulethe abalinganiswa abafihlakeleyo / abalawula okanye umxube oyingozi wezikripthi. Thelekisa iminwe ngaphambi kokuthembela kweli gama.
cfGuideText: Yenza ithokheni ye-API kunye nezicwangciso zeAkhawunti: Funda, Izikripthi zaBasebenzi: Hlela, kunye noGcino lweKV lwabasebenzi: Hlela, emva koko uncamathisele ngezantsi.
helpSetCloudflareQuick: Igcina ithokheni ye-Cloudflare API encamathiselwe kwesi sixhobo, iqinisekisa iakhawunti, idala i-namespace ye-KV kunye ne-subdomain workers.dev ukuba iyafuneka, ihambisa i-Breeze Worker, kwaye ijonge i-/api / impilo kwinyathelo elinye.
mockReply: Le yimpendulo yedemo enkonkxiweyo. Akukho myalezo uthunyelweyo.
mockGroupReply: Le yimpendulo yeqela. Akukho myalezo uthunyelweyo.
mockSeedA1: Molo! Le ngxoxo ibonisa ukuba umyalezo ofunyenweyo ujongeka njani.
mockSeedA3: Yonke into apha ihlala kwesi sixhobo.
mockSeedB3: Ewe. Iimpendulo ziveliswa ekuhlaleni emva kokulibaziseka okufutshane.
mockSeedG2: Oku kunceda ukubonisa ukuba iincoko zeqela zijongeka njani.
helpSetTabOrder: Utshintsha ulandelelwano lwee-tab ezisezantsi. Tsala umqolo, okanye usebenzise amaqhosha e-arrow; Ibha yethebhu ihlaziya kwangoko. Iincoko zinokuphinda zihlaziywe, kodwa zihlala zibonisiwe.
helpSetInstallApp: Ivula ukufakwa kweapp yonqakrazo olunye xa isikhangeli sibonelela. Ukuba loo prompt ayifumaneki, ibonisa imiyalelo yokufaka okanye ibhanile yokukhuphela desktop endaweni yoko.
notifAskDesc: I-Breeze inokukwazisa xa kufika umyalezo omtsha okanye umnxeba, naxa ujongene nenye i-app. Akukho nto malunga neencoko zakho ephuma kwesi sixhobo ukwenza oku, kwaye unokucima izaziso nanini na kwi-Settings.
